**→ 82 + 2 = 64 + 2 = 66.**

questions.question: Raziya Sultan was the first and only female ruler of the Sultanate, who ascended the throne in:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1236 AD**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Raziya Sultan ascended the throne in 1236 AD, making her the first and only female ruler of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• She was the daughter of Shams-ud-din Iltutmish, the third ruler of the Mamluk dynasty of Delhi.
 
• Raziya Sultan was known for her administrative skills and efforts to promote justice and equality in her kingdom.
 
• Despite facing opposition from the nobility, she managed to rule effectively for a short period.

• The Delhi Sultanate was a Muslim kingdom based mostly in Delhi that stretched over large parts of the Indian subcontinent for 320 years (1206–1526).
 
• Five dynasties ruled over the Delhi Sultanate sequentially: the Mamluk (Slave) dynasty, the Khilji dynasty, the Tughlaq dynasty, the Sayyid dynasty, and the Lodi dynasty.
 
• The Sultanate is known for its cultural and architectural contributions, including the construction of Qutub Minar and the establishment of Islamic architecture in India.

• The Mamluk Dynasty, also known as the Slave Dynasty, was the first dynasty to rule the Delhi Sultanate from 1206 to 1290.
 
• It was founded by Qutb-ud-din Aibak, a former slave who became a general and later the Sultan of Delhi.
 
• The dynasty is noted for its military prowess and the establishment of a centralized administrative system in Northern India.
 
 
 
• **Raziya Sultan**
 
 
• Raziya Sultan (1205–1240) was the first and only female ruler of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• She was known for dressing like a man and leading her troops into battle, challenging the traditional gender roles of her time.
 
• Raziya was a competent and just ruler, but her reign was cut short due to internal conflicts and opposition from the Turkish nobles.
 
• Her legacy remains as a symbol of female empowerment and leadership in a male-dominated society.

questions.question: By which National Waterways (NW) of India, are the delta channels of Mahanadi and Brahmani rivers and East Coast Canal connected?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**NW 5**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **NW 5** stands for National Waterway 5 in India.

• NW 5 connects the **delta channels of Mahanadi and Brahmani rivers** and the East Coast Canal.

• National Waterway 5 is a significant part of India's inland water transport system.

• It plays a crucial role in the transportation of goods and resources through the states of Odisha and West Bengal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **National Waterways in India:**

• India has a network of inland waterways in the form of rivers, canals, backwaters, and creeks.

• National Waterways are a key component of the inland water transport system in India.

• The Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) is the statutory authority in charge of these waterways.

• NW 1: Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly river system from Allahabad to Haldia (1,620 km).

• NW 2: Brahmaputra river from Dhubri to Sadiya (891 km).

• NW 3: West Coast Canal from Kottapuram to Kollam (205 km).

• NW 4: Godavari and Krishna rivers along with Kakinada-Puducherry canal (1,095 km).

• NW 5: East Coast Canal integrated with Brahmani and Mahanadi delta rivers (588 km).

• **Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI):**

• The IWAI was constituted in 1986 by an Act of Parliament.

• It is responsible for the development and regulation of inland waterways for shipping and navigation.

• The authority primarily undertakes projects for the development of infrastructure, including dredging, construction of terminals, and navigation aids.

• **Importance of Inland Water Transport:**

• Inland water transport is cost-effective and environment-friendly.

questions.question: If secθ = √2, then cosecθ is equal to:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For standard trigonometric angles, we know that sec45° = √2.

Comparing this with the given secθ = √2, we get θ = 45°.

We need to find the value of cosecθ.

Substituting θ = 45° into cosecθ, we get cosec45° = √2.

**∴ The correct answer is √2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

secθ = √2

**Formula Used:**

secθ = Hypotenuse / Adjacent

cosecθ = Hypotenuse / Opposite

Opposite = √(Hypotenuse² − Adjacent²)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/581be8b903e08ba1415907e27ad0751a22fd994f8aa2d8b2b04112f86b1a78a0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ secθ = √2 / 1

⇒ Comparing with the formula, Hypotenuse = √2 and Adjacent = 1

⇒ By Pythagoras Theorem: Opposite = √((√2)² − 1²)

⇒ Opposite = √(2 − 1) = √1 = 1

⇒ cosecθ = Hypotenuse / Opposite

⇒ cosecθ = √2 / 1 = √2

**∴ The correct answer is √2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Reciprocal Identities

sinθ = 1 / cosecθ | cosθ = 1 / secθ | tanθ = 1 / cotθ

Trigonometric Values for 45°

sin45° = 1/√2 | cos45° = 1/√2 | tan45° = 1

Pythagorean Identities

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 | 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ | 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ
</p

questions.question: In how much time (in years, rounded off to 2 decimal places) will ₹10,800 amount to ₹24,800 if invested at simple interest at the rate of 15.5% per annum?

Interest = Amount − Principal = ₹24,800 − ₹10,800 = ₹14,000

Time = (Interest × 100) ÷ (Principal × Rate)

Time = (14000 × 100) ÷ (10800 × 15.5)

Time = 14000 ÷ 1674 ≈ 8.36 years

**∴ The correct answer is 8.36 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Amount (A) = ₹24,800

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (I) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + I

**Calculations:**

⇒ I = A − P

⇒ I = 24800 − 10800

⇒ I = 14000

⇒ 14000 = (10800 × 15.5 × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 14000 = 108 × 15.5 × T

⇒ 14000 = 1674 × T

⇒ T = 14000 ÷ 1674

⇒ T = 8.363...

⇒ T ≈ 8.36 years

**∴ The correct answer is 8.36 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

Interest calculated strictly on the original principal amount for the full duration. Given by: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Compound Interest (CI)

Interest calculated on the initial principal and also on the accumulated interest of previous periods. Formula: Amount = P × (1 + R ÷ 100)T.

SI vs CI Difference

For the first year, Simple Interest and Compound Interest are identical if compounding happens annually. Differences start to accumulate from the second year onwards due to "interest on interest."

questions.question: Find the greatest value of 'k' in a 6-digit number 6745k2 such that the number is divisible by 3.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For divisibility by 3, the sum of digits must be a multiple of 3.

Sum of digits of 6745k2 = 6 + 7 + 4 + 5 + k + 2 = 24 + k.

Since 24 is perfectly divisible by 3, 'k' must also be a multiple of 3.

Possible single-digit values for k are 0, 3, 6, and 9.

The greatest possible value among these is 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The 6-digit number is 6745k2.

The number is perfectly divisible by 3.

**Formula Used:**

A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of all its digits is completely divisible by 3.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of digits = 6 + 7 + 4 + 5 + k + 2

⇒ Sum of digits = 24 + k

⇒ For the whole number to be divisible by 3, (24 + k) must be a multiple of 3.

⇒ Since 'k' is a single digit, its maximum possible value can be 9.

⇒ Let's substitute the highest possible digits starting from 9:

⇒ If k = 9: Sum = 24 + 9 = 33 (33 is divisible by 3)

⇒ If k = 8: Sum = 24 + 8 = 32 (32 is not divisible by 3)

⇒ Since 9 is the highest single-digit number and it perfectly satisfies the divisibility condition, k = 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule for 3

A number is completely divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is a multiple of 3.

Divisibility Rule for 9

Similar to 3, a number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is a multiple of 9.

Divisibility Rule for 6

A number is divisible by 6 if it satisfies both the divisibility rules of 2 (ends in an even digit) and 3.
</p

For a system of linear equations, check the ratio of coefficients of x and y.

Ratio of x coefficients = 3/2

Ratio of y coefficients = 2/3

Since 3/2 ≠ 2/3, the lines intersect at exactly one point.

**∴ The correct answer is Unique solution.**

**Given:**

Equation 1: 3x + 2y = 7

Equation 2: 2x + 3y = 7

**Concept Used:**

For a system of linear equations a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂:

⇒ If a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂ → Intersecting lines (Unique solution)

⇒ If a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂ → Coincident lines (Infinite solutions)

⇒ If a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂ → Parallel lines (No solution)

**Calculations:**

⇒ From the given equations, a₁ = 3, b₁ = 2, c₁ = 7

⇒ And a₂ = 2, b₂ = 3, c₂ = 7

⇒ a₁/a₂ = 3/2

⇒ b₁/b₂ = 2/3

⇒ c₁/c₂ = 7/7 = 1

⇒ Comparing the ratios: 3/2 ≠ 2/3

⇒ Since a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂, the system of equations has exactly one point of intersection.

**∴ The correct answer is Unique solution.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Consistent System

A system of linear equations is called consistent if it has at least one valid solution (either a unique solution or infinite solutions).

Inconsistent System

A system is called inconsistent if there is no set of values that satisfies both equations simultaneously (this corresponds to parallel lines).

Graphical Meaning

A unique solution means the two lines intersect at exactly one coordinate point (x, y) on the graph.

questions.question: Amit's father is aged five times more than Amit. After 6 years, he would be three and a half times of Amit's age. After further 9 years, how many times of Amit's age would he be?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present ratio (Father : Amit) = (1 + 5) : 1 = 6 : 1, and after 6 years = 3.5 : 1 = 7 : 2.

Both ratio parts increase by exactly 1 unit (7 − 6 = 1 and 2 − 1 = 1) over 6 years.

∴ 1 part = 6 years ⇒ Present ages are 36 (Father) and 6 (Amit).

After 15 years (6 + 9), ages will be 51 and 21 respectively.

Required ratio = 51 ÷ 21 = 17/7 = 2 ³/₇.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 ³/₇ times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0af0ce96f87ab03d43ddcd1e13777912b3ceeece7f4710021804a6670a727b3c.png] 

**Given:**

Father's present age is 5 times **more** than Amit's age.

After 6 years, Father's age = 3.5 × Amit's age.

**Calculations:**

Let Amit's present age be x years.

⇒ Father's present age = x + 5x = 6x

After 6 years:

⇒ Amit's age = x + 6

⇒ Father's age = 6x + 6

According to the given condition:

⇒ 6x + 6 = 3.5 × (x + 6)

⇒ 6x + 6 = 3.5x + 21

⇒ 6x − 3.5x = 21 − 6

⇒ 2.5x = 15

⇒ x = 15 ÷ 2.5 = 6

Present ages:

⇒ Amit = 6 years

⇒ Father = 6 × 6 = 36 years

After a further 9 years (Total 6 + 9 = 15 years from present):

⇒ Amit's age = 6 + 15 = 21 years

⇒ Father's age = 36 + 15 = 51 years

Required ratio of Father's age to Amit's age:

⇒ 51 ÷ 21 = 17/7 = 2 ³/₇ times

**∴ The correct answer is 2 ³/₇ times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

"Times" vs "Times More Than"

The numerical difference in ages between any two individuals always remains constant at any point in time, whether in the past or in the future.

questions.question: A thief is spotted by a policeman from a distance of 100 m. The thief starts running and the policeman chases him. If the speed of thief and policeman are 21 km/h and 23 km/h, respectively, then how far will the thief have to run before he is over taken?

⇒ 1 unit = 100 ÷ 2 = 50 m

⇒ Distance run by the thief = 21 units = 21 × 50 = 1050 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1050 m.**

Distance between policeman and thief = 100 m

Speed of thief = 21 km/h

Speed of policeman = 23 km/h

Relative Speed (same direction) = Speed₁ − Speed₂

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Relative speed in m/s = 2 × (5 ÷ 18) = 5/9 m/s

Relative Speed in Opposite Direction

When two bodies move towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗₐₜᵢvₑ = S₁ + S₂.

questions.question: PQ is the diameter of a circle with centre A. M is a point on the circumference of the circle. If m∠MAP = 110º, then find the value of m∠MQA.

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is exactly double the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circle.

Here, arc PM subtends ∠MAP at the centre A and ∠MQP at point Q on the circumference.

⇒ ∠MQP = ∠MAP ÷ 2

⇒ ∠MQA = 110º ÷ 2 = 55º

**∴ The correct answer is 55º.**

**Given:**

PQ is the diameter of the circle with centre A.

m∠MAP = 110º

**Concept Used:**

Angles on a straight line add up to 180º.

Angles opposite to equal sides in an isosceles triangle are equal.

The sum of all internal angles in a triangle is exactly 180º.

**Calculations:**

Since PAQ is a straight line, ∠MAP and ∠MAQ form a linear pair.

⇒ ∠MAQ = 180º − ∠MAP

⇒ ∠MAQ = 180º − 110º = 70º

In ΔMAQ, the sides AM and AQ are radii of the same circle.

⇒ AM = AQ

Since opposite angles of equal sides are equal in a triangle:

⇒ ∠AMQ = ∠MQA

The sum of all angles in ΔMAQ is 180º:

⇒ ∠MAQ + ∠AMQ + ∠MQA = 180º

⇒ 70º + 2 × ∠MQA = 180º

⇒ 2 × ∠MQA = 110º

⇒ ∠MQA = 55º

**∴ The correct answer is 55º.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle at the Centre Theorem

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is exactly double the angle subtended by the same arc at any point on the remaining part of the circle.

Angle in a Semicircle

The angle subtended by a diameter at any point on the circumference is always a right angle (90º).

Angles in the Same Segment

Angles subtended by the same arc at any two points on the circumference in the same segment of the circle are always equal.
